bounded_audio.fixture: emulator-generated QEMU TEST sample; no proprietary PCM

fault_found_and_fixed.symptom: Trig 1 caused an IPL7 UART8 fault-report flood and vector 191 could not enter.
fault_found_and_fixed.cause: The note hook used a memory-destination CMPI.L form accepted by MiniColdFire but unsupported by the live ColdFire core path.
fault_found_and_fixed.correction: Use a stack-neutral absolute JMP detour, MOVE.L 12(A0),D3 plus CMPI.L #1,D3, and MOVE.W mask,D3 plus BTST D2,D3.

scope_limit: This proves desktop transport, live shadow-state ingestion, bounded renderer interrupt lifecycle, nonzero generated-sample WAV transport, and subsequent UI responsiveness. It does not prove physical hardware timing or sustained realtime playback.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: No firmware, project data, factory sample names, extracted MAIN, or proprietary PCM is committed.
